_comment: Read by Claude Code and by grok (both resolve .claude-plugin/plugin.json).
Both expand ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} and the shell-style ${VAR:-default} form —
established by calling a tool through a real plugin install, see MCP-011.
KANMER_NODE lets a machine with no Node on PATH point at the Kanmer desktop
binary, which runs this bundle as Node because of ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE. Plain
Node ignores that variable, so it is set unconditionally.
No --root: the server discovers the board from cwd (ADR-0012, MCP-010).
Do NOT copy the sibling .mcp.json's cwd form here — it breaks grok's handshake.
